[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Alask Vrei''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[baron]] of a [[Unidentified Twi'lek clan|clan]]. He lost his holdings, but discovered a talent for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] tactics. He then became an [[Officer/Legends|officer]].<ref name="Gamer 9" />

Vrei was decorated for bravery during his service, and was outwardly aloof, and treated his crew as subjects, but also played hardball if need be. He was considered to be harsh but fair.<ref name="Gamer 9" />

He used a hold-out blaster, datapad, comlink, holoprojector, and recording rods in the military. He could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Lekku]], and [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]].<ref name="Gamer 9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alask Vrei is used as an example of a character in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' in the [[2002]] article ''[[On Wings of Rogues]]'' in [[Star Wars Gamer 9|''Star Wars Gamer'' 9]].<ref name="Gamer 9" />
